_purpose: Plain-language Git questions mapped to exact commands. Each variant states when it applies, how dangerous it is, and how to undo it.
_tech: JSON, consumed by app.js and served raw for scripts and AI agents
_description: Seed set covers the highest-voted Git questions on Stack Overflow plus daily essentials. Modern commands (switch, restore) first, legacy forms noted.

danger_levels.safe: Changes nothing you cannot get back.
danger_levels.history: Rewrites commit history. Coordinate before doing this to shared branches.
danger_levels.destructive: Can lose work permanently. Read the note before running.
